About

Hello! My name is Stoyan, and I live in Voorburg. After previously living in the Netherlands and working for various construction companies, I moved back in 2017 and founded The Home Renovator.

Over the past years, The Home Renovator started as a side project and a passion of mine — combining my love for home renovations with the satisfaction of seeing happy clients when a project is completed.

This year, I decided to dedicate more time to this passion. I now work part-time for an engineering company building water systems, to be able to spend more time working on renovation projects, practising sports, and enjoying time with my two-year-old daughter.

I would love to support you with your renovation projects, whether big or small, and help turn your ideas into a home you truly enjoy living in.
